title: AI Gets Your Wallet
script: What happens when your AI gets a spending limit? Payment companies are already building infrastructure for purchases made through AI agents. Now imagine groceries ordered while you sleep, and a flight booked before the fare changes. You set the budget. It decides which purchase deserves it. Then it buys something you never would. The receipt says approved. By whom? Would you give an AI a thousand-dollar limit?
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: Buying flights, cancelling subscriptions and negotiating offers leads to a question about spending authority.
whyNow: A present capability creates a plausible human decision; this is a scenario, not a forecast.
viewerGoal: Consider the human consequence and choose a boundary.
hooks: What happens when your AI gets a spending limit?
Your AI bought this. You never tapped approve.
The receipt says approved. But by whom?
strongestHook: What happens when your AI gets a spending limit?
directorBrief: Direct this as a human story about Buying flights, cancelling subscriptions and negotiating offers leads to a question about spending authority. Emotional movement: curiosity → control. Open with a recognisable person or object, introduce one consequence, then leave the final choice unresolved. Fictional dates and interfaces are scenario details. Facts must be separately sourced; use a small persistent POSSIBLE FUTURE label, never a news-like breaking banner.
effort: 60–120 minutes asset production and edit; no audio included.
protocol: Produce original story assets, review factual grounding, verify every future claim is conditional or explicitly fictional, then inspect continuity and safe zones. No real-world experiment outcome is claimed.
evidenceRequirements: Verify agentic-payment infrastructure; future autonomous household budgets remain speculative.
